itemListElement.name: How to Choose Welding Management Software

mainEntity.name: What should I look for in welding management software?
How do I know a tool will actually hold up in an audit?
How is welder qualification and continuity tracked?
Should welding software handle NDT and PWHT?
Is on-premise or cloud better for welding records?
How does Elenchon fit into this?

acceptedAnswer.text: Elenchon is the on-premise archetype above: a self-hosted appliance that runs the full WPS/WPQR/WPQ workflow, weld traceability, equipment and consumables in one system, with pricing published in the open. It's built so the software does the work rather than digitizing paperwork. See the platform, open pricing, or the on-premise vs cloud comparison.
